user.title: Olight Ostation
user.description: The station is controlled entirely over your local network. You need its Tuya device ID and local key — see the README for how to read them from the Olight app.

reconfigure.title: Update the station's address or key
reconfigure.description: Station {device_id}. Re-pairing or a factory reset makes Tuya issue a new local key, and DHCP can move the IP; update either here without removing the device.

init.title: Ostation safety options
init.description: Controls that can change charging behavior are disabled by default. Enable them only if you want Home Assistant to write to the station.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the station. Check the IP address and the local key, and close the Olight app — the station accepts only one local connection at a time.
error.invalid_device_id: A Tuya device ID is 22 characters long.
error.invalid_local_key: A Tuya local key is 16 characters long.

abort.already_configured: This station is already set up.
